description:
Promote BenchBox to Theseus v0.2.11 (release B) in one PR: lock values and workflow refs, `consumer.review_guidance: .github/review-guidance.md`, `minimize_superseded: true` (unless the rehearsal recorded a token refusal), and the review-v2.md gate-pending doc. This installs the verdict-first body and thread writer and the guidance reader for BenchBox PRs.
Decision gates (owner decisions 2026-11-12): the PR may be prepared and opened in parallel with the Theseus self-lock, but it is armed only after theseus-v0211-rehearsal-first-reviewed-pr-20261112 records GO. Minimising stays off if the rehearsal recorded a refused token.
Rollback: revert PR; its review runs under v0.2.11, so a broken reviewer needs an owner stand-in (report, never post one).
Guardrails: BenchBox AGENTS.md write workflow (worktree, preflight, explicit staging, no force push, make pr-open/pr-arm); recompute and verify every lock value independently; hosted SHIP on the final head; no owner-only actions (stand-ins, adjudications, owner instructions, backoff resets); no live model calls; no ruleset change.
